issue_context.title: bulkio: Error message when incorrect cron syntax for schedules is extremely confusing / not helpful
issue_context.body:
When running something like `CREATE SCHEDULE ... RECURRING '* * haha'` it errors with `ERROR: missing field(s)` which is very confusing if it's in fact an invalid option / invalid cron syntax.

Error should help the user reach the best answer, either `Invalid schedule occurrence on 'RECURRING': Must be either valid cron or XYZ` something like that.

review_comments: Will it be the same message for `RECURRING` and `FULL BACKUP`?
well, this one will be set when we try to pick recurrence.  I added another file to this pr to make sure the error is the same(ish)
Is the error that we get back here useful? If so, it might be worth wrapping?
By here, I mean the error we get back from `cronexpr.Parse`.
No, it's not useful at all.
